source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Exercise the GPU-baseboard PCIe switch temperature channel through approved warning and critical thresholds while traffic traverses the mapped switch, verify correct SEL and PCIe/platform protection, then prove every upstream and downstream path recovers.
original_method: The source requires GPU-driver initialization, IPMI observation and heating, but does not identify the PCIe switch or ensure a generic GPU workload traverses its ports and raises the switch temperature.
manual_activity: An engineer maps TEMP_GB_PEX_SW to the exact switch and ports, approves traffic that demonstrably traverses it or a qualified thermal fixture, confirms power/cooling margin and link recovery, and remains present with abort authority.
required_inputs: switch vendor/device ID, BDF or management identity, firmware, physical location, SDR and independent probe map
complete upstream/downstream port, lane, negotiated width/rate and endpoint UUID/BDF topology
validated GPU/PCIe driver, switch telemetry and traffic-generator versions
traffic matrix proving the target switch/ports are traversed, plus bandwidth/duration and power/thermal coupling
temperature limits, hysteresis, SEL event data and expected fan/throttle/link-reset/shutdown behavior
AER/replay/error baselines, abort conditions, cooldown and switch/endpoint/host recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not assume GPU load traverses the target switch; verify the actual path and stable endpoint identities before traffic starts.
Do not heat or obstruct an unidentified switch or alter thresholds. Keep traffic within approved bandwidth, power and thermal limits.
Continuously monitor switch temperature, independent probe, port width/rate/state, AER, replay and vendor error counters, downstream device presence, GPU XID/driver, power, fans, host and BMC.
Abort immediately on AER escalation, link retrain/reset, width/rate degradation, endpoint disappearance, overshoot or management loss; preserve first evidence and do not auto-retry.
Stop traffic/stimulus, restore cooling and verify the complete topology, endpoints and host recover before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, capture immutable switch/port/endpoint topology and bind TEMP_GB_PEX_SW to its SDR and probe.
Run only the approved traffic matrix that traverses the switch or monitor engineer-operated thermal equipment, while synchronizing IPMI/SEL, switch, PCIe, GPU, power/fan and console telemetry.
Correlate warning/critical assert/deassert with traffic and protection behavior and verify every affected port and endpoint returns to baseline width/rate and error state.
Do not infer topology, apply physical heat, reset links, clear errors/logs, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve switch/sensor/port topology, stack, traversing traffic or fixture, power/thermal envelope, event/link-protection matrix and recovery.
Provide physical oversight and emergency abort during the threshold transition.
Assess PCIe fabric anomalies and issue the DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor reads are useful baseline evidence, but generic GPU warming neither proves switch-path traffic nor collects SEL, port, AER or recovery evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection synchronized with immutable PCIe topology, switch/vendor telemetry, a verified traversing traffic matrix, independent temperature, AER/replay/error, endpoint and host monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, PEX_SW target, high-level IPMI commands, threshold-crossing requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain; Project defines actual traffic and dwell.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT PEX SWITCH TOPOLOGY AND TRAFFIC PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the sensor to the switch and ports, baseline topology/error counters, apply bounded traversing traffic or qualified fixture, correlate SEL/link protection, then cool and verify every path and endpoint recovers.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU-baseboard PCIe switch, port topology, endpoint population, firmware and cooling design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board, switch ID/firmware, BMC/SDR, GPU UUID/BDF, driver, switch tool and traffic-generator versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor switch thermal limits, port/error telemetry, BMC event mapping and PCIe fabric recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds switch identity, path-qualified traffic, port/error counters and full data-path recovery rather than relying on generic GPU temperature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A hot GPU or changing switch sensor alone cannot prove traffic crossed the intended switch or that all PCIe paths remained healthy.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Switch/port map, qualified traffic/stimulus, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal or traffic stress may trigger retraining, width degradation, endpoint loss or an AER storm before the switch sensor reaches its critical threshold.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may choose traffic, chamber or a qualified local fixture, but must record the original method, actual switch paths, traffic coverage, equivalence limits and any unexercised ports. A workload on a bypass path is partial evidence only.
expected_evidence: switch ID/BDF/firmware/physical sensor/SDR and independent-probe map
upstream/downstream ports, lanes, width/rate and endpoint UUID/BDF topology baseline
approved traversing traffic or fixture, bandwidth/power/thermal envelope and abort record
timestamped switch/BMC temperatures, SEL events, port states, AER/replay/vendor errors, endpoint/GPU/power/fan/host data
decoded warning/critical assert/deassert and any fan/throttle/link/protection timing
stopped traffic, cooldown, restored topology/width/rate/error baseline, endpoint/host/BMC health and engineer verdict
